conversations.prompt:

An error occurred: Error: warning: not deleting branch '11-create-a-file-browser-for-mobile-so-no-vscode-is-needed' that is not yet merged to
         'refs/remotes/origin/11-create-a-file-browser-for-mobile-so-no-vscode-is-needed', even though it is merged to HEAD.
error: The branch '11-create-a-file-browser-for-mobile-so-no-vscode-is-needed' is not fully merged.
If you are sure you want to delete it, run 'git branch -D 11-create-a-file-browser-for-mobile-so-no-vscode-is-needed'.

Check for this if possible, but also handle the exception in the cycle and skip, not abort.
conversations.answer: Certainly. The error you're seeing happens because the local branch is considered as not fully merged even though it may be merged to the HEAD. This can happen if the branch is not yet merged into its upstream counterpart.To address this, we will:Explicitly check for branches that are merged into the HEAD.Handle the exception during the deletion process, logging the error but continuing with the next branch.Here's the adjusted shell script:[CODE_BLOCK_0]This script modifies the branch deletion process in clearBranches.js to handle errors during the deletion of individual branches and continue with the rest.
